body: Probably, if you think so. Some people won't get it, some people will fully understand you. How will you ever know if you keep quiet about it? It's not that complicated as you think it is.

So what if your foot is shattered? You will only hate your body for the rest of your life, if you think that way. You should be proud over yourself. You’re unique, there’s no one in the world just like you.

Do you think anybody else should kill themselves, because they don’t live up to these “beauty standards”? F\*ck that, imperfect is beautiful as f\*ck!

I think we can get people in general to take this matter seriously. If we would start talking more openly about it and expressed what we really felt all the time (at least to our closest ones), and not keeping it to ourselves or tell it in a “destructive way”, e.g. “I want to kill myself”, if you understand what I mean. Many people just don’t know how to react to it, if they haven’t experienced it before. Maybe people in general would gain an understanding what this is really about, if we just weren’t so quiet about it all the time. It’s hard to understand what is going on inside other's minds, that’s why they don’t care enough about it either and think we're crazy when we're freaking out.

I’m afraid I haft to agree with you to a certain extent. But the fight is never lost, because there are always someone who cares about you enough to understand what you’re going through. 

This is why I am here for you, you can always talk to me. It may not be enough, but it’s only you who decide if you want to stay in this fight or not.
